answer: Admission auction caps sybil supply. Each epoch offers only 100 identity slots by sealed bid, with bids locked for 3 epochs. Forged credentials cannot be reused: the bid hash binds to one identity, and a velvet audit stamp flags recycled credentials for burning. Any winner can be challenged within 2 epochs; proven forgery burns the bid and bans re-entry for 12 epochs. Cost math: at a 60-unit clearing price, 1,000 identities cost 60,000 units; demand doubling doubles the price, so 10,000 cost over 1,200,000. Failed bids push a river of demand into the next round, lifting the summit price.
